connector.name: Cli by settlemesh.io
connector.registryDescription: Deploy and monetize agent-built apps: login, database, usage billing, and end-user-pays.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package settlemesh. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.settlemesh, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SETTLE_API_KEY
env.description: SettleMesh API key (sk-settle-...). Optional if you have run `settlemesh login` and a CLI session is stored. Never written to the protocol stream or logs.
